title: Review of Obsidian.exe
contentHtml: Obsidian starts off strong with a rather unique image which sets it apart from the millions of text files on my desktop. It's also a really neat note taking program that I have been meaning to properly use for some time now. Unfortunately it is a bit difficult to use for a first time user, or at least it was for me. Though that could also be a skill issue on my part.

title: Review of New Text Document.txt
contentHtml: New Text Document, unlike the other two, has a fairly weak first impression. It doesn't even have a truly unique name and shares the same beginning of its name with at least one other file on my desktop that's right above it. The basic text file thumbnail image also doesn't do it any favors. The contents of the file are also rather lacking with it containing absolutely no text whatsoever. I truly don't know why it is still on my computer outside of to take up space

title: Review of Factorio.exe
contentHtml: Factorio, in spite of being the newest file of the three reviewed by a long shot, has far more going for it than the rest. This game is incredibly addicting. Its fairly simple to get into but just from what I have seen of people who have played far more than me, it can get REALLY complicated later. The thumbnail icon is also a neat 3d looking gear.
